title: Spectral positivity
abstract: Perron-Frobenius theory, Jentzsch's theorem, and matrix/operator positivity in Lean 4. At the matrix level it proves that nonnegative matrices have nonnegative powers, the Metzler decomposition and positivity of the matrix exponential of a Metzler matrix, M-matrix inverse positivity, and the Perron-Frobenius theorem for irreducible nonnegative matrices (a positive dominant eigenvalue with a strictly positive eigenvector). At the operator level it proves Jentzsch's theorem for compact self-adjoint positivity-improving operators on L2 — a simple, strictly positive ground state with a spectral gap — together with a kernel positivity criterion.

informal.allpos_has_pos_eigenvec: A matrix with all strictly positive entries has a positive eigenvalue with a strictly positive eigenvector (Perron-Frobenius for positive matrices, via the Collatz-Wielandt characterization).
informal.perron_frobenius: An irreducible (primitive) nonnegative matrix has a positive eigenvalue with a strictly positive eigenvector.
informal.ground_state_strictly_positive: The ground eigenfunction of a compact self-adjoint positivity-improving operator on L2 is strictly positive almost everywhere (Jentzsch).
informal.SpectralPositivity.Matrix.MMatrix.invers: The inverse of a nonsingular irreducible M-matrix is entrywise strictly positive.
